name: Launchpad Search
description:
Search bar on Super+Alt+Space: apps, open windows, calculations, unit conversions, commands, files, system actions, web search and results from the overview search providers.

Pressing Enter on a calculation or conversion copies the result to the clipboard. Unit conversions use GNOME Calculator.

Searches starting with ? are sent to DuckDuckGo to show the first 10 web results.

Keyword searches (for example @y for YouTube) and the shortcut can be changed in the preferences.

German translation by Malte H. (https://github.com/raqu1n). Thanks!
